author: vladthegreat100
body:
Hey Everybody!

I just wanted to apologise for the way I've been acting in the past few days and especially to the Staff who had to deal with the forum rants :] It came out of pure hatred for some ddos threats w/ staff present but after talking with a few people and a few incidents happening over skype I've come to realise that I was wrong about how I reacted, and even though the staff that were there at the incident could have done something I've forgiven them :P
And to repay for all the damages/flame done I've decided what not better than support the servers with some useless ranks to give to someone to enjoy being able to join any team, get a few extra credits, or even a permanent rank :)
All it will be is an upgrade of whatever rank you got before.
Also staff are you able to do rank upgrades? Or will it be buy the previous rank to upgrade/same rank to go to permanent rank twice? Because I'm sure many of us have a permanent rank (even if its gold or Emerald).

The way that the Giveaway will work is that you comment the person's ign that you want to have the rank given to (Can be you, can be someone else) and if they are picked they will get the win!!! You may only be entered once and I will notify you if you nominate someone who has already been nominated. I will make & upload & give out the prize to the winner on January 1st 2016.

Thanks guys and sorry again. I don't expect for you guys to accept the apology but so I know I won't be known as a total dick head throughout the community I've decided to apologise.
Thank to Iron as well for having a nice talk with me yesterday :)
Also its my birthday when I post this and so is Annamarie (In Eastern TIme at least). So wish her a happy birthday too!!! We are both turning 16 :)

Have a great day!
Best Regards,
~vladthegreat100
